newsitem.title: USA: Tristar revises Q2 shr/loss to $0.10.
newsitem.headline: Tristar revises Q2 shr/loss to $0.10.

text.p: Tristar Corp said Tuesday it has revised its reported earnings per share for the thirteen and twenty-six week periods ended March 1, as a result of the required recording of a non-cash item attributable to the issuance of convertible preferred stock during the period.

The net loss per share, as adjusted, has grown to $0.10 in the second quarter, instead of a loss of $0.04. For the twenty six weeks ended March 1, the company now reports a net loss of $0.05 per share instead of a proft of $0.01 a share.
The company said the revisions were the result of recent staff recommendations by the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Per share amounts in the year-earlier periods, a loss of $0.15 in the quarter and $0.14 for the 26 weeks, were unaffected.

Tristar makes and sells designer alternative fragrances, contemporary cosmetics, and selected toiletry products, sold primarily to chain stores, mass merchandisers, retail outlets, distributors, and wholesalers.
